newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bollore sees H1 pretax profit 335 mln Fr.
newsitem.headline: Bollore sees H1 pretax profit 335 mln Fr.

text.p: French industrial conglomerate Bollore Technologies said on Friday it expected a first-half pretax, pre-exceptional profit of 335 million francs, up 4.5 percent.
Bollore gave the unaudited estimates as part of its offer to buy out minorities in SCAC Delmas Vieljeux (SDV), Bollore said in a statement.
SDV expects to post a first-half pretax pre-exceptional profit of 340 million francs, up 25 percent, it said.
Bollore's results would take into account the negative impact of lower turnover of its plastic films and special paper division, due to lower volumes and prices.
SDV's results reflect the growth in international trade, which benefits its transport division, and strength in the tobacco division, it said.
